i2c_note: PCAL6408A is a fixed-function I2C 8-bit IO expander, not an MCU alt-fn mux. SDA/SCL are single-purpose silicon pins -- no possible_roles menu, function_class=fixed applies to them specifically. Per the interim protocol-pins-only standard (adopted after INA219's STOP #2 -- see kb/vendor/ti/INA219AIDCNR.json provenance.a0_a1_decision), ADDR (address-select), RESET_N, INT_N, the P0-P7 port pins, and VDD(P)/VDD(I2C)/VSS supply pins are deliberately NOT KB'd here. On jetson-agx-thor-baseboard (U71), none of these excluded pins land on the I2C_SYS bus -- ADDR and RESET_N are isolated (unconnected/local) nets, INT_N and P0-P7 have their own dedicated nets, VDD(P)/VDD(I2C) tie to +3V3 -- so this landing carries no STOP-2-shape strap-on-bus churn risk. Unlike AT24CS01 (U54), U71's SDA/SCL wiring on this board is already correct (no pre-existing swap).
